jobs.title: Chief Artificial Intelligence Architect
jobs.description:
The Bank is accelerating its transformation by placing artificial intelligence at the core of its business and technology strategies. AI is a key enabler for innovation, operational efficiency, and hyper-personalized customer experiences. To support this ambition, we are creating a strategic role dedicated to shaping the Bank’s AI architecture vision.
The rapid evolution of generative and agent‑based AI introduces new architectural, operational, and risk challenges that cannot be addressed through traditional solution or data architecture practices alone. This role exists to ensure the Bank can leverage AI at scale, at speed, and within its risk appetite, while preserving security, regulatory compliance, ethical standards, and enterprise coherence .

You are a senior architect recognized not only for your ability to combine strategic vision with deep technical expertise in AI, but also for your strong leadership presence and your ability to influence peers, executives, and multidisciplinary teams. You thrive in uncertainty and fast‑moving environments, consistently demonstrating initiative, sound judgment, and accountability. You are comfortable taking decisions, assuming responsibility for them, and constructively challenging internal stakeholders as well as vendors, partners, and suppliers to protect the Bank’s interests and raise the quality of outcomes. You balance time‑to‑value with risk management, challenge the status quo when needed, and foster collaboration across disciplines. You operate naturally at the executive level, leveraging your credibility, clarity, and structured approach to create real impact through your leadership and vision.
Your role
: 

Define and evolve the Bank’s enterprise AI architecture strategy, roadmap, and reference architectures in alignment with business priorities, enterprise architecture, and risk appetite.
Establish pragmatic AI principles, guardrails, and reusable patterns that accelerate delivery while ensuring consistency, reuse, and control across the organization
Lead the architectural vision for generative and agentic AI, ensuring solutions are secure-by-design, auditable, and operable at enterprise scale.
Define enterprise patterns for agentic systems, including autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop controls, lifecycle management, and safe-stop mechanisms.
Partner with AI delivery, governance, business, data, and technology stakeholders to drive a coherent enterprise AI approach, clarify decision rights, and translate opportunities into scalable golden paths.
Advise executives on AI-related investments, platform and vendor choices, adoption sequencing, and trade-offs between speed, control, and risk.
Oversee AI risk management, emerging technology assessment, and architectural escalation for complex or high-risk AI initiatives.

Your team: 

 As Chief AI Architect, you are accountable for defining and driving the Bank’s enterprise AI architecture strategy, including the reference architectures, guardrails, and scalable patterns required to enable AI adoption and operationalization across the organization. Reporting to the Chief Architect, you ensure that AI solutions can scale safely, remain aligned with enterprise standards, and operate within the Bank’s risk appetite.

Prerequisites
:

Minimum of 15 years of experience in enterprise and/or solution architecture, including significant hands-on experience in AI-related domains.
Deep expertise in AI technologies, including machine learning, generative AI, agent-based systems, and the enterprise platforms required to operationalize them.
Strong understanding of AI governance, ethics, regulatory constraints, and risk management in large organizations.
Demonstrated experience designing AI reference architectures, defining enterprise guiding principles, and shaping scalable architectural patterns.
Solid knowledge of data platforms, MLOps / LLMOps, and cloud-native AI services such as AWS and Azure.
Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence executives and senior peers, challenge stakeholders constructively.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Architecture Governance, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Cloud-Native Architecture, Coaching, Decision Making, Diversity & Inclusion, Domain-Driven Design, Empathy, Enterprise Architecture, Event Driven Architecture, Initiative, Mobilization, Resiliency, Solution Architecture, Teamwork, Web Architecture

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

jobs.title: Digital Payments and Tokenized Assets Leader
jobs.description:
As a Digital Payments and Tokenized Assets Leader at National Bank, you will play a key strategic role in defining how digital money, tokenized deposits, stablecoins, and distributed ledger technologies can transform payment flows, settlement models, and client experiences. Drawing on your experience in payments strategy, digital product development, financial market infrastructure, and technology ecosystem management, you will help position the Bank at the forefront of responsible innovation in tokenized payments and digital assets.
Your Role

Define and lead the Bank’s strategy for digital payments and tokenized assets payments to support the evolution of payment and settlement models.
Develop and evolve the roadmap of capabilities required to deliver digital payment solutions, including connectivity, liquidity management, interoperability, and integration with existing payment rails.
Establish governance, risk management, compliance, and control frameworks adapted to digital assets and evolving regulatory environments.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with industry stakeholders to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of innovative payment solutions.
Identify, evaluate, and bring to market high-value use cases in digital payments and tokenized assets.
Mobilize multidisciplinary teams around a common vision that promotes responsible innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Your Team

Within the Payments team is made up of specialists who work in an agile, proactive, and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, remain at the forefront of market trends, and continuously improve the way we work.
Within this sector, you will contribute to strategic initiatives that are shaping the future of financial services. You will collaborate with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to accelerate innovation and create value for our clients.
We strive to offer you maximum flexibility to support your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning through action, allow you to master your role and develop new areas of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at all times.
Prerequisites

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field combined with significant experience in strategy, technology, or financial services.
Proven experience developing, launching, or scaling products, services, or infrastructure related to payments, digital assets, stablecoins, tokenized deposits, tokenization, blockchain, or distributed ledger technologies.
Strong understanding of regulatory, Solid understanding of regulatory, risk, compliance, financial crime, and prudential considerations applicable to digital assets, tokenized money, payment systems, and emerging financial market infrastructures.
Experience building strategic partnerships and managing complex stakeholder ecosystems.
In-depth knowledge of payment technology platforms, digital asset infrastructure, security, resilience, interoperability, data flows, and integration between traditional banking systems and blockchain-based networks.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.
Required skills: Business Alignment, Critical Thinking, Data-Driven Decision-Making, Decision Making, Emotional Intelligence, Innovation Management, Managerial Courage, Mobilization, Partner Development, Resiliency, Risk Management, Strategic Vision, Strategy Execution, Stress Management

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategic Initiatives, Wealth Planning
jobs.description:
Provides operations expertise in the design, development, management and implementation of assigned projects from business case development through to execution. Works across BMO to deliver specific project/program results in alignment with overall group goals.

Acts as a trusted advisor to assigned business/group.
Influences and negotiates to achieve business objectives.
Identifies emerging issues and trends to inform decision-making.
Assists in the development of strategic plans.
Builds change management plans of varying scope and type; leads or participates in a variety of change management activities including readiness assessments, planning, stakeholder management, execution, evaluation and sustainment of initiatives.
Leads or participates in defining the communication plan designed to positively influence or change behaviour; develops tailored messaging; and identifies appropriate distribution channels.
Acts as a relationship manager on assigned projects/programs and ensures alignment to overall enterprise and group goals.
Develops solutions and makes recommendations based on an understanding of the business strategy and stakeholder needs.
Participates in project/program design and provides advice & subject matter expertise to achieve required business results.
Conducts analysis required to inform strategic recommendations and considers the “big picture” when assessing whether or not a course of action is advisable in terms of the group and enterprise goals.
Collaborates with internal & external stakeholders to provide business context in the design, develop and implementation of programs & solutions.
Breaks down strategic problems, and analyses data and information to provide insights and recommendations.
Monitors and tracks performance, and addresses any issues.
Drives cross business/group coordination and logistical support for the implementation of change.
Supports development and execution of strategic initiatives in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
Works on initiatives with varied complexity, typically involving multiple stakeholders across BMO.
Identifies enablers and key issues prior to and during implementation, raises issues with stakeholders and offers solutions to resolve issues or risks that jeopardize delivery.
Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.
Provides specialized consulting, analytical and technical support.
Exercises judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems within given rules.
Works independently and regularly handles non-routine situations.
Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.

Qualifications:

Typically between 5 - 7 years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Subject matter expertise in required business domain - In-depth.
Deep knowledge and technical proficiency gained through extensive education and business experience.
Verbal & written communication skills - In-depth.
Collaboration & team skills - In-depth.
Analytical and problem solving skills - In-depth.
Influence skills - In-depth.
Data driven decision making - In-depth.

Salary:

$70,000.00 - $150,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at https://jobs.bmo.com/ca/en

BMO is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. To request accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Note to Recruiters: BMO does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to BMO, directly or indirectly, will be considered BMO property. BMO will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for service to submit resumes.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance – Greenhouse Industry | $100,000–$140,000 + Bonus

Leamington, Ontario | Full-Time | Permanent | On-Site

Are you a hands-on finance leader who can go beyond reporting the numbers and help shape business decisions? Do you have experience with cash flow, budgeting, financial controls and strategic planning?
We are recruiting a Director of Finance to join an established greenhouse business in Leamington, Ontario.
Applicants from Amherstburg, Harrow, Kingsville, Leamington, Wheatley, Tilbury, Chatham, Comber, Essex, Belle River, Lakeshore, Puce, Tecumseh, Windsor and surrounding area are encouraged to apply.

The Role

This is a hands-on leadership position within a business of approximately 75–110 employees depending on the growing season.
You will be responsible for:
· Month-end close, reconciliations and financial reporting
· Weekly management reporting, variance analysis and forecasting
· A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory accounting and purchasing controls
· Maintaining a rolling 26-week cash flow forecast
· Banking relationships, credit facilities, debt and working capital
· Annual operating, capital and cash flow budgets
· Maintaining a 3-year integrated financial model
· Internal controls, approvals and financial governance
· Cost control, margin analysis and profitability improvement
· Developing company and departmental KPIs
· Supporting the CEO with investments, pricing, capital expenditure and growth decisions
· Building dashboards and introducing finance automation and AI tools
· Managing and developing a small 2 + 1 finance team
· Identifying and managing government grants, subsidies and tax incentives

About You

· Senior finance leadership experience
· Strong financial planning, reporting and commercial decision-making skills
· Experience with banks, business owners and the CRA
· Strong knowledge of cash flow forecasting, budgeting, financial modelling and internal controls
· Experience developing and tracking business KPIs
· Greenhouse, agriculture or agri-food experience is an asset
· Must hold a valid Canadian Social Insurance Number

Compensation & Benefits

· $100,000–$140,000 base salary
· 10-15% bonus (individual + company performance)
· Salaried with benefits and 4 weeks’ vacation
· Permanent position on the client's payroll
· Potential for partial remote work after the initial 6-month training period

What's Next?

Ready to take ownership of the finance function and help shape the next stage of growth? Apply today
